ServiceConfig.cleaning_additionalOptionsInfo:
'

💦Cleaning service contains:

HOME SPACE

  • Vacuuming or sweeping and mopping floors and cleaning the entry space

  • Dusting all the accessible surfaces

  • Wiping down cupboard fronts

  • Arranging the toys and household items

  • Taking out the garbage & cleaning the bins

  • Removing dust from all accessible lamps Removing the cobwebs

  • Cleaning the mirrors and frames

  • Cleaning plinths and skirting boar Wiping down the doors and handles

  • Wiping down the switches and sockets Setting the washing machine with the selected laundry

  • Unloading the washing machine and hanging the wet clothes on the clothes dryer or putting them in the dryer machine

  • Pulling dry clothes out of the dryer and folding them

  • Leaving cleaning tools in good order: cleaning mop, vacuum cleaner, etc.

✔KITCHEN

  • Washing the dishes and cleaning the sink

  • Wiping down external kitchen surfaces (cabinets, countertops)

  • Cleaning the oven, microwave and the toaster

  • Removing limescale from the kettle

  • Emptying the dishwasher

  • On request: arranging and washing the interior of the fridge

✔BEDROOM

  • Changing the bed sheets and making the bed

✔BATHROOM

  • Washing and disinfecting the toilet, shower, bathtub and the washbasin

  • Wiping the mirrors and glass surfaces

✔LIVING ROOM

  • Cleaning the tables, chairs

  • Vacuuming the sofa, arranging the cushions, etc.

✔BALCONY

  • Cleaning the floors and the railings

'

AboutPage.whoAreWe__text:
'

Nice to meet you! 👋

We are Sylwia and Thibault, polish and french cofounders (guess who is from where 😀). Our adventure started with a COVID lockdown, when work, kids, family, cleaning, cooking, stressing, relaxing, fun and much more, all happened in one place: Home 🌸

Highly motivated we decided to create the service we wanted for ourselves. A service that would give us more time (sometimes, just a little bit 🙂) and a better lifestyle at home, with a focus on proximity, quality and real human exchanges.

Nothing comes easy and we are going through many iterations to propose the best services, from Masaż na Minuty (back when we were massaging people directly in the streets of Krakow 😅) to Homie. Today we’re proposing massages, cleaning, flowers delivery and carpet cleaning and who knows maybe more soon 😉

We’re always available for your question and feedback so feel free to contact us anytime you need!

'

portraitsSection.textSylwia: Whatever you need, Sylwia will do her best to make it happen. She makes our service personalised and human. Always on the field, you will probably meet her when using our services. She answers in polish and in english! 🙂
portraitsSection.textTibo: Behind the website, Thibault is working to make your booking experience faster and friendly. He is working hand-in-hand with Sylwia to coordinate all our missions and making sure we get the best quality services.

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes. Our homies reach every district {cityLocative} and the surrounding areas — with no extra travel fee within the city.
faq.q2: What is the difference between standard and deep cleaning?
faq.a2: Standard is regular upkeep. Deep cleaning is far more thorough — it includes windows, the inside of cabinets, the fridge and the oven.
faq.q3: Do I have to be home during the cleaning?
faq.a3: No need. If you go out, just let us know how to get in and lock up after the service.
faq.a4: Yes, we arrive with eco-friendly cleaning products. We only ask you to prepare the tools: a vacuum or broom, a mop and a bucket.
faq.a5: Of course. You can set up recurring cleaning — weekly, bi-weekly or monthly — and manage it from your account.
faq.a6: You see the quote before confirming your booking and manage payment conveniently online from your account — with no hidden costs.
faq.a7: Absolutely! We love animals and the cleaning price stays the same. Just make sure your pets are safe, for example when we open and clean the windows.
faq.q8: What if I am not happy with the cleaning?
faq.a8: Get in touch — under our satisfaction guarantee we will come back and fix whatever needs fixing.
faq.q9: Are the cleaning products safe for children and people with allergies?
faq.a9: Yes. We use eco-friendly, household-safe products — safe for children and pets.
faq.q10: Can I reschedule or cancel a visit?
faq.a10: Yes. You can reschedule or cancel a single visit by contacting us; you can change a recurring service from your account.
faq.q11: How do I count the number of windows to clean?
faq.a11: Count the number of window sashes or separate panes of glass divided by frames — that is the number of windows to select when ordering.

block_2.para: A company that offers attractive prices and high-quality services allows you to save time and financial resources. Instead of spending your free time on cleaning, you can focus on other important tasks, and the company's prices will help you save money.

In massage we trust ✊

There is a moment for everything and massage is one of them! Any time of the week, our certified massage physiotherapists come directly to your place, with portable massage table, oils and good music to make you feel good ☺️

We like to keep it simple so we design simple massage and duration offers to fit your needs.

relaxation.heading: Relaxation
relaxation.body: The most popular. This massage works with soft or strong intensity but also as a stress killer, a romantic evening, a gift or after a hard day. Be careful, you might end up sleeping a little 😉

deepTissue.heading: Deep Tissue
deepTissue.body: You want to stretch your muscles, release the body pressure and feel like a marshmallow? Deep tissue is the best candidate! 😁

sportive.heading: Sportive
sportive.body: Efficient combo with your active lifestyle & workouts. This massage stimulates your body with a lot of energy so you get pumped for the week! 💪

targeted.heading: Targeted
targeted.body: Your home office setup is giving you hard times? You got a muscle cramp? We'll focus on the parts that bother you the most (for hours even 😈)!

homies.homie1_description: Close your eyes... You're in Bali! That's exactly how we feel every time Wiktoria comes to our place. She is never in a rush and will take good care of each of your muscles.
homies.homie2_description: You can tell how much Anita love her job by the quality and generosity of her massages. She works with children during the day and "relax" performing massages.
homies.homie3_description: Without a doubt he is a physiotherapist by vocation! During the massage you will learn all about fascia, tissues, tendons, muscles. He performs strong massages, With Mateusz, the "suffering" factor is in the package 😈

faq.question_1: How to choose the right type of massage?
faq.answer_1:
If you want to relax, release slight muscles tension or gift someone, we recommend relaxation type of massage. Deep tissue and sport massage are dedicated to people with reduced pain sensitivity or deeper located tensions.
No matter which type of massage you book, our homie will adapt the strength and massage scope to your personal needs and muscles tension.
faq.question_2: How should I prepare to my massage?
faq.answer_2:
Before your massage arrange us a little bit of space to set up portable massage table.
Prepare yourself a bigger towel or a blanket and stay in your underwear or light, comfortable clothes. Relax and enjoy!
faq.question_3: What kind of materials do you provide?
faq.answer_3: We provide all the necessary equipment and accessories to perform your massage, taking care of yours and our homies safety due to Covid-19. We come to you with a portable massage table, liners, surface disinfectant, oils (natural or hypoalergical), optionally speaker.
faq.question_4: How the massages for 2 people are organised?
faq.answer_4: Massages for two are performed one by one, by selected massage therapist, according to your preferences.
faq.question_5: What are the contraindications to massage?
faq.answer_5:
'

  • all conditions with high body temperature (above 38° C), acute and subacute inflammatory conditions
  • selected periods of pregnancy (we don’t provide massages to pregnant women)
  • skin discontinuity, early period after fractures, sprains and dislocations - in such cases, individual healthy joints can be massaged
  • all kinds of dermatological changes
  • cars, bruises, skin inflammations, varicose veins - in such cases, only healthy parts of the body can be massaged
  • allergies to cosmetics used for massage
  • haemorrhages or a tendency to their occurrence
  • uncompensated heart defects, aneurysms, fresh blood clots, fresh heart attack
  • malignant and non-malignant neoplasms
  • post-traumatic strokes in joints and muscles (up to 3 days after injury)
  • phlebitis
  • osteomyelitis with fistulas
  • cavities of the spinal cord
  • all cases requiring surgical intervention
  • persons after surgical procedures. (Massage can be performed 12 months after surgery if it was major and 6 months after minor if the scars are well healed)
  • peptic ulcer disease with bleeding
  • liver and kidney stones
  • hemorrhagic diathesis (platelet, vascular, plasma origin)
  • cardiovascular disorders (hypertension, left atrioventricular valve defects)
  • anemia mainly related to iron and folic acid deficiency
  • leukemia
  • kidney diseases (acute renal failure, glomerulonephritis, pyelonephritis, congenital renal defects)
  • pancreatitis
  • gestational diabetes
  • gestosis - a syndrome characterized by hypertension, proteinuria, and edema
  • hyper- and hypothyroidism and parathyroidism
  • people with fever of unknown origin
  • women during menstruation
  • individuals over 80 years of age
  • patients diagnosed with hemophilia
  • individuals with vascular skin.

'

faq.question_1: Can I choose flowers & colours of my bouquet?
faq.answer_1: We make flowers compositios based of seasonal flowers, that's why we don't provide the choice of exact flowers. We can easily arrange the dominant colour of your bouquet - just leave us a note in a comment and we will match it to your preferences.
faq.question_2: Can you attach a small letter to my flowers?
faq.answer_2: Yes! :) Leave us a note in a comment and we will attach a letter (free of charge) to flowers you ordered.
faq.answer_3: At Homie you can get 2 bouquets sizes, medium - that is circa 30cm diameter and large one - that is circa 40cm diameter.
